title: Set the risk-evaluation contract that 6 teams adopted unchanged
summary: I designed the generic document that carries context into a fraud-evaluation platform's risk API, won approval from senior and principal engineers, and wrote the onboarding guides that let 6 client teams adopt it with no change to its structure.
what_would_have_happened: Each new client would have needed its own payload, and the platform's contract would have split.
the_call: Make one generic contract that fits many clients and use cases, and take it through senior design review before building.
what_i_did: Wrote the use case, prototype and design, got it approved by senior and principal engineers, presented the API to the director, and built the model and client handler.
what_changed: The first version of the API launched on it, and 6 clients onboarded with little developer effort and no structural change.
